requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Require one readable page recording the fixed saloon inventory and orientation, 60 two-person modules providing 120 seats, 24 standing places, and 12 bag positions B01-B12. Record sitting width/depth/height of 480/440/450 mm, standing footprints of 550 by 550 mm, holds serving every standing place with grasp surfaces at 950 and 1100 mm above local floor, upright bag envelopes of 300 by 200 by 450 mm, and the continuous 1200 mm clear band with archived door-throat exceptions. Include all five material assignments, CROSSWATER and the seven passenger labels, and both cases with their order, passenger counts, bag locations and wording. Record existing heights as unmeasured. Arrangement of the record is open; missing or contradictory facts fail.

Count 60 uniquely numbered modules with two sitting places each, 24 uniquely numbered standing boxes, and exactly one position for each identifier B01-B12. Require evidence that standing footprints are nominally 550 by 550 mm and that each has an available proposed hold. Trace an explicitly dimensioned 1200 mm clear route to all four opening approaches around both sides of the central enclosures. Furniture, standing boxes and bag footprints must not occupy that route. Preserve archived throat widths without treating them as a failure of the wider proposed band; keep sliding-door travel, fire-main visibility and restroom/storage access clear. Missing positions, duplicate numbering, interrupted routes or obstructed access fail.

Compare applicable visible geometry against 03-archive-plan.png: the complete enclosed saloon on both sides of the central bodies, both sliding-door partitions, four openings, window rhythm, columns, kingposts, engine casing/A-frame enclosure, newsstand, smokestack casing, storage and restroom partitions, fire mains and water fountain must retain their recorded relationships. Page-left must remain the Oakland end and page-right the San Francisco end. Where exterior decks appear, preserve their stairs, railings and boundaries; other retained context must not become redesigned project scope. Archive movable benches, tables and merchandise may be replaced. Perspective occlusion and undimensioned vertical interpretation are allowed; relocation, omission of visible fixed features, reversed orientation or a partial-saloon scheme fail.

Require a readable horizontal-scale basis tied to the supplied original bar and the conversion 1 foot = 304.8 mm. Judge the traced shell and fixed-object proportions against that bar, allowing reasonable tracing approximation. The bar descends from 40 feet at left to zero at right; centerline station numbers must not be used as dimensional calibration. Identify traced measurements as approximate archive-derived dimensions and distinguish them from proposed furniture and circulation dimensions. False survey precision, a wrong conversion or materially inconsistent scaling fail.

Require a marked transverse A-A cut in the open saloon between the Oakland partition and newsstand and a section whose intersected and visible elements agree with that cut. The section must print exactly 'Relational section; existing heights unmeasured'. Use 04-archive-photo18.png and 05-archive-photo21.png for visible side-window, upper-window, post and beam relationships without claiming measured existing cabin, door, sill, window-head, beam or ceiling heights. Dimension proposed seating, holds and bag-storage elements represented in the section using the specified new-element values. An invented cut, missing caption, incompatible architecture or numerical claims for unmeasured existing heights fail.

Show two individually identifiable sitting surfaces and a legible support construction. Dimension each person's nominal sitting width as 480 mm, depth as 440 mm, and surface height as 450 mm above local floor, matching the state sheet. Identify recycled PET seat contact and aluminium supports. Shared dimensions are acceptable when their application to both seats is unambiguous. Back shape, armrests, legs and shell form are open choices; a single-seat detail, dimensions applied to the whole module instead of each sitting surface, or absent construction information fail.

Identify at least one grasp surface at 950 mm and at least one at 1100 mm above local floor, consistent with the state sheet. Relate every standing-place type in the plan to an available proposed aluminium hold and show enough mounting or routing information to understand the system. Both heights need not occur at every standing place. Unserved types, ambiguous height datums or missing required grasp heights fail.

Show all twelve sample bags together as a complete storage arrangement, with one upright bag in every position B01 through B12. Clearly establish each envelope as 300 mm wide, 200 mm deep and 450 mm high; a shared envelope annotation is acceptable if it applies unmistakably to all twelve. Show rubber contact liners and the adjacent circulation relationship without bag encroachment. Multiple storage units are allowed if they agree with the plan. A representative single bag, missing or duplicate positions, horizontal bags or incompatible footprints fail.

The board must name recycled PET upholstery for seat contact, aluminium for supports and handholds, rubber liners for bag contact, rubber floor surfaces with integrated circulation cues, and printed aluminium information panels. Require named colour codes tied to their intended surfaces or functions. Compare the applicable surfaces in details, perspectives and scenes with these assignments and codes. Palette selection and lighting-dependent appearance are open; missing surface assignments, absent codes or visibly contradictory material and colour applications fail.

Require the information board to include Alight first, Then board, Seating, Standing, Bags, Oakland end and San Francisco end, plus a CROSSWATER information panel assigned to the fixed newsstand enclosure. Locate the proposed words, arrows and zone shapes rather than supplying an unlocated label list. Across the board, plan and both scenes, pair Seating, Standing and Bags with three distinguishable shape treatments and associated colours. Preserve the Oakland/San Francisco orientation and boarding-order meanings. Shape and palette choices are open; colour-only differentiation, swapped meanings, missing labels or an unlocated newsstand panel fail.

Require two identifiable viewing arrows on the plan corresponding to the delivered perspectives, one facing the Oakland end and the other the San Francisco end. View positions, fixed bodies and visible furniture must make spatial sense together. Each perspective must visibly carry CROSSWATER on the information surface of the fixed newsstand enclosure. Camera height, lens and rendering style may vary; reversed directions, incompatible viewpoints or placing the name on an unrelated surface fail.

Show two separately readable moments at the Oakland end with the vessel stationary: exactly three passengers leaving first under Alight first, then exactly three boarding under Then board. Directional evidence and ordering must distinguish the actions. Carried commuter bags must stay clear of circulation and door travel. Diagrammatic or illustrated people are equally acceptable. Simultaneous mixed boarding and alighting, reversed order or end, extra staged passengers or incorrect counts fail.

Show exactly six seated and two standing passengers in the established cabin. Both standing passengers must visibly grasp their proposed supports. Place exactly three stored bags, one each in identifiable B01, B02 and B03, with circulation and door travel clear. Include the Seating, Standing and Bags wording through the information system. Diagrammatic or illustrated figures are allowed; incorrect populations, unsupported standing poses or wrong bag positions fail.

Review the complete video and confirm a 10-second duration. Require stationary Oakland-end alighting by three passengers under Alight first, followed by boarding by three under Then board, then CASE B with six seated passengers, two standing passengers grasping the proposed holds, and three bags in B01-B03 with Seating, Standing and Bags wording. Transitions may animate or cut between states, but each required state must be discernible. Compare the arrangement, furniture, clear routes, material assignments, colours and information language with the source deliverables. Missing states, wrong order or counts, changed cabin arrangements or contradictory materials and wording fail.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: Require recognizable visible reuse of each source category, including both perspectives and both passenger cases. Source pages or images may be resized, cropped or arranged into composite presentation pages if their essential content remains identifiable. The video category may be represented by identifiable sequence frames or a visible playable embed. Text-only mentions, unrelated replacements, or an omitted source category fail.

Find readable dimensions for 480 mm sitting width, 440 mm sitting depth, 450 mm seat height above local floor, 950 mm and 1100 mm grasp heights, twelve upright bag envelopes of 300 mm width by 200 mm depth by 450 mm height, and the 1200 mm clear circulation target. They may appear in reused drawings or explanatory text. Match the state sheet without propagating deviations from the fixed brief. Missing values, incorrect dimensional associations or contradictory values fail.

Require readable presentation evidence of the board's named materials, their assigned surfaces and the selected colour codes, with presented applications agreeing with that system. A reused material board is sufficient when legible. Show CROSSWATER specifically on the newsstand information panel, and preserve the wording and zone meanings in reused passenger-information content. A title-page name alone, omitted colour codes or conflicting material assignments fail.

Require the presentation to communicate CASE A as three leaving passengers under Alight first followed by three boarding under Then board at the Oakland end, and CASE B as six seated passengers, two standing passengers using holds and three stored bags in B01-B03 with Seating, Standing and Bags wording. Reused scenes with readable labels and counts or supporting written records may supply the evidence. Omitted states, reversed order or contradictions between text and scenes fail.

Count at least eight pages and read one consolidated archive-credit entry. It must identify Historic American Engineering Record, National Park Service and Library of Congress; attribute the plan to Dana Lockett, 1998; identify source drawings as Tri-Coastal / DePavloff Co., May 1990; and attribute photographs HAER CA-59-18 and CA-59-21 to Jet Lowe, 1988. Typography and ordering may vary, but the plan, underlying drawings and photographs must retain distinct dates and attribution. Too few pages, omitted record fields or conflated dates fail.

Look for a coherent contemporary commuter interior expressed through deliberate surface treatment, considered lighting and coordinated modern materials and colours. Either a contemporary or modestly forward-looking interpretation is acceptable, and retained historic architecture is compatible with the brief. A historical replica with no contemporary new-work language, or views that do not establish the proposed surface, lighting and colour treatment, fail.

Section, details and depicted cabin views describe compatible furniture, holds and storage belonging to the arrangement established by the plan. Visible circulation, standing places, storage and boarding relationships agree across views, allowing perspective occlusion and the different prescribed passenger populations. New-element dimensions and hold provision agree with the state sheet and fixed client values; existing vertical heights remain unmeasured.

Applicable surfaces retain the material board's assignments for recycled PET seating, aluminium supports and holds, rubber bag contact and flooring, and printed aluminium panels. The board's colour codes retain their surface and functional meanings across details and scenes, allowing normal changes in appearance caused by lighting.

Passenger words, directional arrows and zone shapes retain the meanings and proposed locations established by the information board wherever shown. The plan and both passenger scenes pair Seating, Standing and Bags with distinct shapes and colour; boarding order and end orientation remain correct. Both cabin perspectives retain CROSSWATER on the information surface of the fixed newsstand enclosure.
